Icon shapes from the npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.79.0.tgz
SHA-512 (base64): 1Oq9qzywx2Sa16LRGju97VvqSMBxq2R9GtBWYW4sfX+qpNJRLNLJq2wWvA4NODfdgknHOJBkqhjxpFRlvXehLg==

The shapes are written directly in study_chat.html as <symbol> elements, so no
icon files are loaded. The brain shape is also used for spectre-studio.ico.

Included: brain, message-square-more, plus, folder-open, refresh-cw, power, send,
file-text, chevron-down, box, layers, graduation-cap, sliders-horizontal, user, clock,
check, minus, wrench, flask-conical, code-xml, briefcase-business, heart-pulse, book-open,
notebook-pen, tag, ellipsis, layout-grid, list, search, pencil, trash-2, house, monitor,
cpu, chart-no-axes-column-increasing.
